name: CORE SPACES, LLC

items.verbatim: 625 Church is a new construction student housing multifamily residential project developed by Core Spaces, LLC in partnership with Schenk Realty Group. The project is comprised of 197 units with accessory assembly amenity spaces throughout the building for exclusive use by the building tenants. / Bu
